system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Below are all the available APIs, including the API name, parameter names, parameter types, default values, return value names, and return value types.
system_prompt_style.note: SYSTEM_PROMPT_TEMPLATE with {all_api_descs} and {all_api_names} variables; line number inferred from the excerpt position.

env_context_strategy.note: Prompt has only the query, the API descriptions and the history. There is no environment to navigate. Retrieval is explicitly not considered (paper Sec. 3.3). Line number not available in the evidence.

context_compaction.note: Run loop experiments/all_experiments.py is not in the evidence bundle. The paper excludes shortcuts longer than 30 because of context limits, but that is dataset filtering, not history compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
The history actions and observations are as follows:
{history_actions}
observation_format.note: The history is rendered as text into the user prompt.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Strictly follow the JSON format below for your output and do not include any irrelevant characters.

tool_count.note: The API count varies per query: max(min(x*|APIs_i|,20-|APIs_i|),0) extra APIs are added (paper Sec. 3.3). Finish is built in. There is no fixed count.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: For each step, use only one API.
edit_primitive.note: Tools are Shortcuts APIs. There is no file-editing primitive.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The APIs are mainly from intent definition file ${filename}.actionsdata from AppIntent (Apple-Inc., 2024b) framework
tool_schema_source.note: Extracted from app definition files rather than hand-written. This is the closest fit to the available categories.

protocol_standardization.note: Dependencies (requirements.txt) and source were not included, so no grep was possible.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: we slightly modified the ReACT (Yao et al., 2023) templates to construct the API-based agents.
loop_primitives.note: Evaluation feeds golden history and predicts the next action (paper Sec. 3.3.1).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: At each step, you need to provide your thought process to analyze the current status and determine the next action

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: You are AutoGPT. Your task is to complete the user's query using all available APIs.
